_comment: Machine-measured 2026-09-05 on station rpi-turret: sha256 over the file, and
inference_rate/task/labels read out of the metadata JSON embedded in the .rpk
itself. license is the imx500-models copyright file's entry for this artefact.
Re-measure and re-review after any package upgrade - §9.3 exists so a changed
artefact stops startup instead of changing what 'person' means mid-run.
layout. The .rpk metadata does not declare them, so §9.2's probe is the
bbox_order, bbox_normalized and the output layout were measured on 2026-09-05 and are
no longer provisional. row_layout/output_tensors describe the four-tensor on-sensor
output; a package upgrade that changes the firmware layout is caught at startup by §9.3
only if the manifest is re-verified — rerun the probe + a sample capture before trusting
notes: sha256 and inference_rate_hz=26 measured from the artefact
on 2026-09-05; labels resolved to the embedded 90-entry list (coco_rpk).
A 320x320-class input sees a person as roughly 20x60 pixels at moderate range:
§36's measurement_quality and §37.1's selectability floor are what keep that from
being mistaken for a good lock, not the detector score alone.

Measured on this station 2026-09-05: on-sensor PP output is four tensors (boxes (100,4), scores (100,), classes (100,), count (1,)); boxes are NORMALIZED yxyx (verified by overlaying both readings on a live frame — the xyxy reading put boxes on the edge and in the ceiling, the yxyx reading on the curtain, the person and the monitor).
